name: VRG S.A.
summary: VRG S.A. designs, manufactures, and sells jewelry and clothing for women and men in Poland and internationally. It operates through the Clothing and Jeweler segments. The company offers classical and avant-garde jackets, well-cut trousers, suits, modern knitwear, coats and jackets, polo shirts, and other accessories; and silk and bow ties, and cufflinks. It also provides gold and platinum jewelry, as well as jewelry with diamonds and precious stones; and watches. The company sells its products under the Vistula, BYTOM, Wólczanka, Deni Cler, and W.KRUK brands.
